title: 第10章 连环计，登闻鼓
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

太后和孙百草的脸色，更是瞬间变得铁青。

这是一个死局！

林墨没有直接拆穿她们的阴谋，而是用了一个谁也无法反驳的理由，把皮球又踢了回去。

现在，难题摆在了太后面前。

这兰花，搬还是不搬？

不搬，就等于告诉所有人，她心里有鬼，是故意装病。

搬了，等她病好了，就等于当着满朝文武的面，承认了林墨的医术，甚至在孙百草之上！

对孙百草这位久负盛名的老神医来说，无异于当众打脸！

而且是左右开弓，打得啪啪响那种！

武太后俏脸寒霜，怎么也想不到，自己布下的必杀之局，竟然被这个小子用如此匪夷所思的方式，给轻松化解了。

良久，她才冷声吩咐：“来人……把那盆花，给哀家……搬出去！”

这话让众人面面相觑。

不少人看向孙百草，神色各异：质问，鄙夷，同情……

孙百草一张老脸，瞬间涨成猪肝色。

可谓羞愤欲绝，恨不得当场找个地缝钻进去。

这场比试，林墨大获全胜！

当林墨回到御书房，找刘烈详细回报此事时。

刘烈龙颜大悦，放声大笑，“哈哈哈……朕就知道，林爱卿你不会让朕失望！”

“这次你做得好，朕重重有赏！”

闻言，林墨脸上欣喜，心中却感觉无比别扭：“额……昨晚睡了你的皇后，今天又重重有赏，怎么感觉怪怪的？”

刘烈刚要开口封赏，一名侍卫，突然神色慌张地从殿外冲了进来，噗通一声跪倒在地。

“启禀陛下！大事不好了！”

刘烈皱眉道：“何事惊慌？”

那侍卫回道：“宫门外来了一大群士子儒生，足有上百人！”

“他们在礼部几位大人的带领下，于宫门外敲响了登闻鼓，说……说要鸣冤！”

“鸣什么冤？！”刘烈诧异道。

“他们说陛下您推行的以工代赈之策，乃是……乃是与民争利，祸国殃民的恶法！”

“他们要求……要求当朝与献策之人对质辩论，否则……否则就要血溅宫门，以死明志！”

消息传来，犹如晴天霹雳！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The expressions of the Queen Mother and Sun Baicao instantly turned livid.

This is a dead end!

Lin Mo did not expose their conspiracy directly, but used a reason that no one could refute and kicked the ball back.

Now, the problem faced the Queen Mother.

Should I move this orchid or not?

Not moving would be tantamount to telling everyone that she had something going on in her mind and was deliberately pretending to be sick.

Moving, when she recovers, it will be equivalent to admitting in front of the civil and military officials of the court that Lin Mo's medical skills are even better than Sun Baicao!

For Sun Baicao, the famous old miracle doctor, this was tantamount to a slap in the face in public!

And it shoots from left to right, making a snapping sound!

Empress Dowager Wu's pretty face was frosty. She never expected that the fatal situation she had set up would be easily resolved by this kid in such an incredible way.

After a long time, she coldly ordered: "Someone... take that pot of flowers to the Ai family... and move it out!"

These words made everyone look at each other in shock.

Many people looked at Sun Baicao with different expressions: questioning, contempt, sympathy...

Sun Baicao's old face suddenly turned the color of pig liver.

It can be said that I was so ashamed and angry that I wished I could find a crack in the ground and crawl into it.

In this competition, Lin Mo won a great victory!

When Lin Mo returned to the imperial study and asked Liu Lie to report the matter in detail.

Liu Lie's face was filled with joy and he laughed loudly, "Hahaha... I knew you would not let me down, Lin Aiqing!"

"If you do well this time, I will reward you heavily!"

Hearing this, Lin Mo's face was filled with joy, but he felt extremely awkward in his heart: "Uh... I slept with your queen last night, and today I got a lot of rewards. Why do you feel so weird?"

Just when Liu Lie was about to open his mouth to award the reward, a guard suddenly rushed in from outside the hall with a panicked expression and fell to his knees with a thud.

"Your Majesty! Something bad has happened!"

Liu Lie frowned and said, "Why are you so alarmed?"

The guard replied: "A large group of scholars and Confucian scholars came outside the palace gate. There were hundreds of them!"

"Led by several adults from the Ministry of Rites, they beat the Dengwen drum outside the palace gate and said... that they wanted to express their grievances!"

"What grievances are there?!" Liu Lie said in surprise.

"They say that the work-for-relief policy implemented by Your Majesty is... an evil method that competes with the people for profit and harms the country and the people!"

"They demand...demand that the government confront and debate the person who made the suggestion, otherwise...otherwise, blood will be splashed on the palace gate, and the will will be revealed in death!"

The news came like a bolt from the blue!
